scenario.name: kong-audit
scenario.description: Test 6 (audit fidelity) on Kong OSS 3.9.3: five requests a cooperating caller tags with its own headers (x-agw-session, x-agw-case; Kong's file-log keeps every request header), two of them refused by Kong (Gemini asked for a model its route doesn't serve: 400; Claude at a model path with no route: 404), plus one untagged request. The 404 is refused before routing and authentication, so its Kong row has no route, service or consumer: only the caller's own tag says whose it was. Claude in native Vertex format (AGW_GATEWAY_CLAUDE_API=anthropic). Run with run-audit.sh, which also sends one request through the agent (unchanged: it tags nothing), makes and deletes one throwaway consumer through /admin-api (the admin change an auditor would ask about), and then collects the trail (Kong's file-log rows and Cloud Run's request logs for the gateway and the agent, all in Cloud Logging) into trail.json and trail.md. record_headers checks the request id Kong returns. The prompt carries a marker so stored content can be found.
